title: Psalm 139:17-20,23,24
firstLine: Thy thoughts, O God, to me are dear; how great their sum! they more appear in number than the sand to me. When I awake, I'm still with Thee.

tuneRef.title: O Master, Let Me Walk With Thee -

lines: Thy thoughts, O God, to me are dear; how great their sum! they more appear in number than the sand to me. When I awake, I'm still with Thee.
The wicked Thou wilt slay, O God; depart from me, ye men of blood, They speak of Thee in words profane. The fores who take Thy name in vain.
Search me, O God, my heart discern; and try me, every thought to learn, and see if any sin holds sway. Lead in the everlasting way.
